common.description: Common UI strings used throughout the application

loading.description: Loading indicator text shown while content is being fetched

error.description: Generic error message shown when something goes wrong

zoom_in.description: Tooltip for the zoom in map control button

zoom_out.description: Tooltip for the zoom out map control button

my_location.description: Button text to center the map on the user's current location

details.description: Link text to view full details of a location

directions.description: Button text to get directions to a location

titlePrefix.description: Prefix for an event's auto-generated title when no name is entered, prepended to the venue/street, e.g. "Meditation at" → "Meditation at Beethovenstraße 12".
